texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 9 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button and a default Text Field. Design all other states, the header, the footer, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the logo, the photos, the social logos and the icons from 04 · Media. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 9 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button and a default Text Field. Design all other states, the header, the footer, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the logo, the photos, the social logos and the icons from 04 · Media.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.

texts.name: Short: Setting the bar as one of the most comfortable sofas in its class, the Asgaard is a compact, sturdy three-seater with a solid-wood frame and deep, soft cushions. Description ¶1: Embodying the relaxed, honest spirit of Scandinavian design, the Asgaard pairs a solid-wood frame with soft, hard-wearing upholstery, built to be lived on every day. Description ¶2: Weighing in at 45 kg, the Asgaard is sturdy without being bulky. Its high-density foam cushions keep their shape, the removable covers are easy to care for, and the low, clean silhouette fits a small apartment as comfortably as a large living room.
